text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm taking a break in the
cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're just the person I wanted to
see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru runs over to me in a
flurry.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Got anything weighing on your
mind?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aww, c'mon! Don't be like that! I don't
care how
trivial it is! I'm all ears!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I received a divine message from the
great
Shiraoki telling me to be kind to
others.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And divine messages are final! So please help me to fulfill it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You got it! Just relax here while I get
you
everything you need!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru brings me drinks and
food in
quick succession.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'll massage your shoulders. Let's
see, I also
need to clean your room after
this, and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you require any more assistance,
please do not
hesitate to summon me,
Master!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you require any more assistance,
please do not
hesitate to summon me,
Master!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh, when did I develop these maid-like

mannerisms?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This must be another blessing from the
great
Shiraoki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I never thought to interpret it that
way. I
still don't know what to do
though...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Treating myself for all the hard
work I've
done...  I guess a small break
wouldn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure this is the right thing to
do?
Shouldn't I be training or
something?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You know what? You're totally right! A
divine
message from the great Shiraoki
could never be
wrong!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you like to join me on my
little break?
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take the time to happily sip on some
tea with
Matikanefukukitaru.
